title: Kuwa Ballanqaaday
intro: Nebi la ixtiraamo ayaa dadka dhex socday, isagoo ugu yeeraya runta. Dad badan ayaa iska jeestay iyagoo madax adag, laakiin koox yar oo daacad ah ayaa ka jawaabtay baaqii waxayna si qalbi furan isu ballan qaaday. Waxaa lagu tijaabiyay shaki waxayna ku dhiiradeen inay raadsadaan quudka jannada. Daacadnimadooda aan kala go'a lahayn waxay noqotay cashar aan waqti lahayn oo ku saabsan iimaanka. Yaa ahaayeen?
clues: Waxaan ahayn koox yar oo u kacday inay taageerto hawlgal rabbaani ah xilligii gaalnimada baahsanayd.
Nebi la ixtiraamo ayaa yimid oo nagu baaqay inaan u istaagno sidii xulufo u ah jidka Alle.
Markii nebigu weydiiyay cidda noqon doonta taageerayaasha Ilaah, waxaan si aan shaki lahayn uga jawaabnay.
Waxaan ku dhiirannay inaan codsanno casho mucjiso ah oo laga soo diray samada si aan u xoojinno quluubteenna.
Nabigeennu wuxuu na xasuusiyay inaan Alle ka cabsano haddii aan nahay mu'miniin dhab ah, haddana codsigeennii is-hoosaysiinta ahaa waa la sharfay.
Waxaan ahayn goobada gudaha ee daacadda ah ee ballan qaaday iimaan aan kala go 'lahayn oo ay weheliyaan Ciise, ina Maryam.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: Hawaaruun (Xertii Ciisaha)
Ashab al-Kahf (Dadka Godka)
Dadka reer Madyan
Reer Thamuud
Asxaabtii Talut (Sawuul)

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: In la weydiisto inay noqdaan taageerayaasha dacwada Alle.
Inaad aragto dood uu taliye la yeeshay nebi
In la amray in la badbaadiyo geel mucjiso ah
U cararidda god si aad uga baxsato cadaadis
Ka gudubka webi si loo tijaabiyo addeecidda
trial.answer: In la weydiisto inay noqdaan taageerayaasha dacwada Alle.

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: Miis laga soo bixiyay samada (Mawlida)
Doontii weynayd ee biyaha daadadka dul saarnayd
Hashii oo ka soo baxday dhagax
Ul isu beddeshay abeeso
Qasri sare oo cirka gaaray

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaan noqonay mu'miniin adag oo guulaysta
Waxaa na halaagnay ciqaab ka timid xagga sare
Waxaa naga qarqiyay daad xooggan
Waxaan ku seexanay god boqolaal sano
Waxaa naloo diiday inaan galno dhulka barakeysan
outcome.answer: Waxaan noqonay mu'miniin adag oo guulaysta

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
